exposure: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) score for risk identification
outcome: Postpartum depression (PPD) as measured by EPDS score
cohort: Postpartum women recruited on their second postpartum day, categorized into high-risk (EPDS score >= 10) and low-risk (EPDS score < 10) groups for PPD.
finding: Early identification of mothers at high risk for PPD followed by Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) resulted in a statistically valid improvement of EPDS scores in high-risk mothers, demonstrating the potential for PPD prevention.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant obstetric risk factor for PPD.
